text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! Nnggh...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Uuugh……!
choice_data_list:
Alright, hold it right there for three 
seconds!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: *Haa*... *haa*... *gasp*...
choice_data_list:
You look wiped out. Shall we extend the 
break by 10 minutes?

Looks like you're having a tough time. 
Shall we extend the break by 10 minutes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our daily fundamental training. While 
average for an Umamusume at this stage, it 
seemed tough on Chrono Genesis.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Next up is the chest expander, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm-hm~♪ Up we go!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Boooooing♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: S-So effortlessly...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan eats just as much as I do. So 
why...?
choice_data_list:
Everyone just grows at their own pace, 
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. That's true... There are early 
bloomers, and there are late bloomers...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: History teaches us so as well...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...That said, the Hanshin JF is coming up 
soon.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(If I fall behind everyone else, it'll 
affect the results as well...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(The Junior Class is a period where it's 
difficult to display one's full strength. 
I already knew that from history, but 
still...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I can't hold back this feeling of 
impatience...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...The Umamusume who made history... all 
endured this agonizing impatience...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(—Once again, you have my utmost 
respect...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Trainer, my current running is as you see.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It has not reached the originally 
projected values. Therefore...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to come up with a strategy to 
win...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis seems to be feeling 
impatient.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She may appear to have a slighter build 
compared to the other Umamusume of her 
generation. However, that is simply a 
difference in body type.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her ability is exceptionally high. Her 
slender frame doesn't seem to be a cause 
for concern at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, feelings are another matter. I 
want to do whatever I can to dispel her 
worries.
choice_data_list: As for what gives Chrono her strength...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Hanshin JF—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...As expected, everyone had trained 
themselves to the utmost...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Things might not go exactly as the 
Genesis Method predicted...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...? Trainer, that newspaper is...
choice_data_list:
The school newspaper. Keep it as a 
good-luck charm, yeah?

The school newspaper. Keep it as a 
good-luck charm, okay?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: A-An amulet...?
choice_data_list:
Because I drew courage from history the 
other day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I was shocked by Almond Eye's Japan 
Cup result, the facts shown by history 
taught me that there was no need to be 
pessimistic.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And when it comes to history for me, it's 
all about 'Casual Historical Tales' in the 
school paper."
choice_data_list:
It's my good luck charm. Want to read it 
too, Chrono?

It's my good luck charm. Want to read it 
too, Chrono?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...! W-Well then...

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"There was once a petite Umamusume who 
boldly continued to challenge those hailed 
as the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"In the final stretch, her small frame 
surged forward, sprinting like an arrow 
released from a bow."

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text: "—It reminds me of that run."

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"The one spoken of was also small in 
stature. The conqueror of the Asahi Hai 
FS—Dream Journey."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though I'm the one who wrote it, 
I completely forgot about it..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much... for this super 
effective charm...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I can take on the Hanshin 
JF with strong determination...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I'll do the very best I can right now!
